QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] The Restored Tree of Memory
QuestInfo.0: The townspeople are happy, and everything has returned to normal now that the Tree of Memory is restored. Chief Legato has something to tell you, before you get on the boat to leave...
QuestInfo.1: Chief Legato was unable to find Kao's memories from the Tree of Memory, but he told you that somewhere within the Vanishing Journey is the Fountain of Reflection. Go tell Kao about it.
QuestInfo.2: Kao intends to locate this Fountain of Reflection. You decided to leave town together and cross the Lake of Oblivion.

0.0: Everything has returned to normal, thanks to you. Everyone has resumed their daily routines...
0.1: Oh, you said you wanted to cross the Lake of Oblivion, yes? Kima, our oarsman, should be in a good enough mood to ferry you across now. Ah, everything's just as it was... although...
0.2: The traveler who looks like you... The one without memory. What they said troubled me...
0.3: They touched the Tree of Memory, hoping to recover their own lost memories. Of course, that's how our crisis began.
0.4: So I gazed upon the tree, but I found no memories pertaining to our mutual acquaintance.
0.5: It's said that somewhere beyond this town, there is a fountain whose waters reflect one's past.
0.6: Of course, that's presuming it's still there... Everything within the Vanishing Journey seems to fade away in time.
0.7: In any case, I would ask you to tell the traveler of this fountain. Will you?

yes.0: Please tell the traveler about the Fountain of Reflection. Perhaps they will find what they seek there.

0.msg: #b(You told Kao what Chief Legato said about the Fountain of Reflection.)#k

1.msg: I didn't know there was a place like that in the Vanishing Journey... Maybe I can find my missing memories there.

2.msg: The Fountain of Reflection... I must find it. I will cross the Lake of Oblivion with you.

3.msg: I should pack my things. I'll meet you by the docks outside of town.

npc.0: Please tell the traveler about the Fountain of Reflection. Perhaps they will find what they seek there.
